positive_claim: A human-adapted generative VLM learns visual and decoder representations that progressively improve a DINOv3 human grounder through visual transfer and semantic transfer.

stage0.role: Document that native Qwen lacks reliable dense human pose and segmentation output; this is motivation context, not a Stage-1 admission gate.
stage0.native_arm: Unmodified Qwen3.5-4B weights and tokenizer with compact numeric JSON.
stage0.confidence: mean generated log-probability over each complete person span
stage0.evaluation: Use the verified historical native box/attribute diagnostic and an optional small format smoke only; no full five-task native run is required before Stage-1.
stage0.naming_rule: Stage-0 means unmodified native Qwen only. Any tokenizer extension belongs to Stage-1 initialization.
stage0.dense_output_interpretation: Segment and pose are unsupported/N/A when the native model does not emit a valid representation; do not spend the main experiment budget forcing a zero-shot grammar it has not learned.

stage1.role: Teach Qwen Vision human structure while Qwen text decoding produces person slots, boxes, attributes, and LISA-style pose/segment routing tokens.
stage1.pre_tuning_control: S1_INIT_LISA_POSE_ROUTING_0STEP verifies short Human Slot text, owner-specific <POSE>/<SEG> states, Qwen-native dense features, and decoder interfaces at zero optimizer steps.
stage1.decoder_contract: Box, gender, age, person ordering, and routing tokens use the native Qwen text decoder. <SEG> and <POSE> hidden states condition mature mask and pose decoders that consume Qwen Vision features.
stage1.mainline_pose_representation: Person-specific <POSE> hidden state conditions a mature box-conditioned SimCC decoder over Qwen Vision ROI features.
stage1.mainline_segment_representation: Person-specific <SEG> hidden state conditions a SAM-style mask decoder whose sole image embedding comes from Qwen Vision features.
stage1.location_vocabulary: Native numeric box tokens; only routing and existing task-anchor tokens are added in active E implementation.
stage1.loss: Text cross-entropy plus mature mask BCE/focal/dice and SimCC pose/visibility losses.
forbidden_mainline_components: SAM image encoder in the mainline
ViTPose/RTMPose image encoder in the mainline
stage1.baseline_policy: S1_INIT_CODEC_0STEP is the matched initialization control for the new vocabulary; native Stage-0 is motivation context only.
trainable_contract: Vision LoRA r16 across all 24 blocks
LLM attention and MLP LoRA r16 across all 32 blocks
allowed_mature_components: SAM/SAM2 mask decoder without SAM image encoder

stage2.role: Test visual transfer from the frozen Stage-1 image encoder to DINOv3.
inputs: the same raw RGB image to DINOv3
frozen Stage-1 visual features through an explicit bridge
trainable: DINOv3-side adapters or selected DINOv3 blocks
stage2.causal_comparison: DINO-only versus base-Qwen visual transfer versus human-adapted-Qwen visual transfer under matched data, initialization, steps, and decoders.

stage3.role: Test semantic transfer from the frozen Stage-1 LLM decoder to the Stage-2 DINOv3 grounder.
frozen: all Stage-1 adapters and token rows
stage3.semantic_source: Image-conditioned hidden states at generated person, pose, segment, age, gender, and task delimiter tokens.
trainable: DINOv3-side adapters or selected DINOv3 blocks
stage3.causal_comparison: Stage-2 versus base-LLM states versus human-adapted-LLM states with random, shuffled-task, and shuffled-person controls.

paper.story_center: Progressive transfer across Stage-1, Stage-2, and Stage-3.
paper.evaluation_policy: Use the same COCO-UniHuman validation records and the paper-aligned no-small-person policy for every comparable result.
paper.evidence_rule: Training loss, teacher-forced output, and GT-conditioned decoding are diagnostic only and never substitute for generated validation AP.
